title: Get started
text: start multilingual book, use quarto_multilingual_book() parent_dir argument specify want create project project_dir argument specify name project. argument main_language used specify main language project further_languages lists additional languages. can set site-url field project’s URL directly using site_url parameter quarto_multilingual_website()/quarto_multilingual_book(). Look _quarto.yml file project directory. get familiar configuration, take look example : file structure project looks like : Quarto file Spanish French version. files aren’t automatically translated just copies original English version. provide translations , look {babeldown} automatic translation. look index.qmd file, ’ll see French file called index.fr.qmd Spanish file called index.es.qmd. ’re ready render book, use render_book(). within directory, don’t need specify project_path argument defaults .. end three books, cross-link left sidebar. Example. default, interactive sessions preview project opened, using servr package. See Previewing multilingual project section details.
code: parent_dir <- withr::local_tempdir() project_dir <- "multilingual_book" babelquarto::quarto_multilingual_book(   parent_dir = parent_dir,   project_dir = project_dir,   main_language = "en",   further_languages = c("es", "fr") ) ✔ Added configuration for en to 'config_path'. ✔ Added configuration for es, fr to 'config_path'. _quarto.yml project:   type: book  book:   site-url: https://example.com   title: "multilingual_book"   author: "Firstname Lastname"   date: "9/1/2026"   chapters:     - index.qmd     - intro.qmd     - summary.qmd     - references.qmd  bibliography: references.bib  format:   html:     theme:       - cosmo       - brand  babelquarto:   languagelinks: sidebar   languagecodes:   - name: es     text: "Version in es"   - name: fr     text: "Version in fr"   - name: en     text: "Version in en"   mainlanguage: 'en'   languages: ['es', 'fr'] title-es: title in es title-fr: title in fr description-es: description in es description-fr: description in fr abstract-es: abstract in es abstract-fr: abstract in fr author-es: author in es author-fr: author in fr lang: en fs::dir_tree(file.path(parent_dir, project_dir)) /tmp/RtmpHtatgW/file8a91c717e9b/multilingual_book ├── _quarto.yml ├── cover.png ├── index.es.qmd ├── index.fr.qmd ├── index.qmd ├── intro.es.qmd ├── intro.fr.qmd ├── intro.qmd ├── references.bib ├── references.es.qmd ├── references.fr.qmd ├── references.qmd ├── summary.es.qmd ├── summary.fr.qmd └── summary.qmd withr::with_dir(file.path(parent_dir, project_dir), {   babelquarto::render_book() })

title: babelquarto (development version)
text: Add support language-specific abstract books. Improve support documentation quarto profiles (now using quarto::quarto_inspect() obtain correct profile-specific configuration). Fix document behavior CNAME files (#120, @luisDVA)

title: babelquarto 0.1.0
text: interactive sessions, render_ functions now override site-url "" previewing servr::httw() works. easier styling, language button now class "babelquarto-languages-button". Add verbosity register_ functions, one can turn option. ## Documentation improvements clarify default value project_path render_book(), “Get started” vignette. clarify default value project_path register_ functions, “Converting existing project” vignette. strengthen case package README. mention site-url param quarto_multilingual_ functions. new section Get started vignette, “publishing project”. clarify languagecodes configuration vignette. clarify site-url configuration vignette. document get icon, configuration vignette. clarify profile naming convention, configuration vignette. clarify BABELQUARTO_CI_URL, render--ci vignette.
